channel.title: Positiva Films — Field Notes & Color Craft
channel.description: Color grading, LUT craft, and field notes for filmmakers shooting weddings, travel, and aerial work across India.

item.title: Color-Matching A7S III to FX3 on a Wedding Multicam Edit (Resolve, 2026)
item.description: Same sensor, same log profile — and the cameras still don't sit on the timeline. The drift, the offset, and the group-grade workflow that locks them up in Resolve.

item.title: Mixed Tungsten + LED + Mandap Fire: A Wedding Reception Node Tree That Actually Works
item.description: Three light sources, three colour temperatures, one subject. The parallel-node tree we run on every pheras segment to keep skin where it should be.

item.title: Why Your LUT Crushes Blacks — A Pre-LUT Exposure Workflow That Saves Every Grade
item.description: Most "the LUT looks bad" calls aren't a LUT problem. They're an exposure-mismatch problem upstream. The four-node tree that fixes it for good.

item.title: Why Indian Skin Tones Go Orange Under Rec.709 Wedding LUTs (And the One Node That Fixes It)
item.description: Most cinematic LUTs are graded against pale Western skin. Apply them to brown skin and the bride goes pumpkin. Here's the qualifier-based fix.

item.title: Why Applying a LUT Directly to S-Log3 Looks Flat — The CST Node You're Missing
item.description: S-Log3 isn't Rec.709. The LUT doesn't know that. Here's the Color Space Transform node every Sony shooter should have wired into their grade.
